claims.quote: Non-Configurable BLT: Generic 0-10 volt dimming driver. Dims to 10%
Tested in accordance with ISO 14644-1; suitable for use in ISO 5-9 positive and negative pressure clean rooms.

args.note: Found the manufacturer's spec sheet for BLT Series which includes the 2BLT4 model. The document title is "BLT.pdf" with revision/update date of "9/21/2026" as shown in the product page's spec sheet table. The future update date indicates the product is still actively maintained and supported.

findings.detail: LED estimated useful life of at least 50,000 hours at 70 percent lumen maintenance, from IES LM-80 data.
Warranty Period for LED Luminaires, including LED modules, LED boards, chips, and drivers: Five (5) years from date of Preliminary Acceptance.
Listed as a qualified DLC product, where applicable.
Package states 3; spec requires at most 3.
Quoted values apply only to Non-Configurable BLT. Confirm the submitted configuration.
Submitted Rev. 07/18/24, web source 9/21/2026. The revision labels differ; their age order is not confirmed.

Please provide the missing information so we can confirm compliance before installation.", "note_to_subcontractor": "Please submit documentation confirming the LED troffer’s rated life (L70 at 50,000 hours), 5-year warranty, DLC qualification, and dimming capability for the specific configuration submitted. No changes were found in the revised document that affect performance values.", "finding_titles": {"spec-req_t_rating_hr_led": "Rated life (L70) not stated", "spec-req_warranty_years_led": "Warranty period not stated", "spec-lt-dlc": "DLC listing not confirmed", "spec-lt-dim": "Dimming performance not confirmed for submitted configuration", "currency-newer": "Revision label differs but no value changes confirmed"}, "why_it_matters": {"spec-req_t_rating_hr_led": "Without verified rated life, we can’t ensure the lights will last as expected in classrooms, risking early replacements.", "spec-req_warranty_years_led": "Missing warranty info leaves us unprotected if fixtures fail prematurely after installation.", "spec-lt-dlc": "DLC listing may be required for energy rebates or compliance—we need proof to qualify for incentives.", "spec-lt-dim": "If the lights don’t dim as specified, teachers won’t be able to adjust lighting for different classroom activities.", "currency-newer": "A different revision number doesn’t mean the content is newer or better—we need actual data, not just a date label."}}
